Seattle Mayor Wilson's Seattle Transit Measure (doubling city transit sales tax) remains in council consideration and cannot close the full gap independently. Third: nationally, battery storage deployment continues accelerating — 2025 YTD exceeded 2024's full-year 10 GW record; 2026 tracking above 2025 — providing growing grid backstop for renewable intermittency.
